edges.reason: constructor assigns owner from msg.sender via Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to change owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
freezeAccount is gated by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
msg.sender is used to index the balances mapping.
msg.sender is used as the owner key in the allowed allowance mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and checks frozenAccount[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom consumes the caller's allowance and writes balances.
approveAndCall grants allowance and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
burn reads and subtracts balances[msg.sender].
Constructor initializes owner state variable.
Constructor sets symbol.
Constructor sets name.
Constructor sets decimals.
Constructor sets totalSupply.
Constructor sets ownerAddress.
Constructor credits balances[ownerAddress] with totalSupply.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
totalSupply() reads the totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply() subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
transfer reads frozenAccount for sender and recipient.
transfer updates both sender and recipient balances.
transfer relies on safeSub to prevent underflow on sender balance.
transfer relies on safeAdd to prevent overflow on recipient balance.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decreases the caller allowance in allowed.
transferFrom checks frozenAccount for from and to.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
approveAndCall first writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall invokes an external contract callback after updating allowance.
The re-entered spender callback can observe or exploit the freshly written allowance state.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
External token call is made with owner as recipient, enabling callback re-entry during the sweep.
burn performs an unchecked balances[msg.sender] -= value.
burn performs an unchecked totalSupply -= value.
Unchecked subtraction directly mutates the balances mapping.
Unchecked subtraction directly mutates totalSupply.
freezeAccount writes the frozenAccount flag for the target.
transfer recipient parameter is consumed by transfer.
transfer amount parameter is consumed by transfer.
transferFrom source parameter flows into balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom destination parameter flows into balance credit.
transferFrom amount parameter flows into subtraction and addition.
spender parameter becomes the target of the external callback.
approveAndCall token amount is stored in allowed and forwarded.
Arbitrary data parameter is forwarded into the external callback.
burn value parameter is subtracted from balances and totalSupply without SafeMath.
tokenAddress parameter determines the external contract that is called.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
target parameter indexes the frozenAccount mapping.
freeze boolean parameter is stored in frozenAccount.
New owner candidate parameter is written to newOwner under onlyOwner.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to serve transfer's balance credit and frozen check.
Amount parameter has no standalone semantics outside the transfer balance arithmetic.
Source parameter is only meaningful as the debited account inside transferFrom.
Destination parameter is only meaningful as the credited account inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter is bound to transferFrom's balance and allowance updates.
Spender parameter is the direct target of the external receiveApproval callback.
Token amount parameter is fully absorbed by the allowance write in approveAndCall.
Arbitrary data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external callback.
Burn value parameter is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction.
Token address parameter selects the arbitrary external contract that is called.
Amount parameter is passed straight into the external ERC20 transfer call.
Target parameter exists solely as the key written into frozenAccount.
Boolean parameter is stored directly as the frozenAccount value.
Candidate owner parameter is only used to stage the newOwner state variable.
